checker: TypeSafe System One Choice (supports / contradicts / says_nothing)
scope: Context claims only. Similarity scores are computed deterministically and never use this check.

lake-salda.claim: Light-coloured lake-edge sediments; NASA notes Jezero shares geological and mineral characteristics with Lake Salda.

death-valley.claim: Landscape NASA likens to Viking 2's view of Utopia Planitia; the Mars 2020 team practised hazard avoidance here.

atacama-yungay.claim: One of the driest places on Earth, used to study how the building blocks of life respond to Martian conditions.

pilot-valley.claim: Salt deposits that help explain how perchlorate, also observed on Mars, can serve as an energy source for microbes.

verde-valley.claim: Field and laboratory research on how biosignatures are preserved, to guide what Mars rovers look for.

vikursundar.claim: Gravel ripples monitored with drone-derived terrain models as analogs of Martian ridges.

askja.claim: Ground-penetrating radar finds buried ice here; the same technology is planned for ice near the lunar south pole.

kilauea.claim: Researchers measure how long volcanic field-geology tasks take, to plan similar work on the lunar surface.

lava-beds.claim: Lava caves explored from inside and out, working towards detecting hidden caves from above ground.

sf-volcanic-field.claim: Moon-like volcanic field where NASA astronauts rehearsed Artemis moonwalks and tested surface technology.

haughton.claim: High-Arctic impact structure with intra-crater sedimentary deposits, including later paleolacustrine (lake) sediments.

meteor-crater.claim: Impact crater whose shocked Coconino Sandstone contains high-pressure silica phases such as coesite and stishovite.

lonar.claim: Impact crater in basalt whose shocked rocks are studied for comparison with Mars.

flevoland.claim: Reclaimed, intensively farmed polder; no planetary-analog use.

iowa.claim: Glaciated cropland plain; no planetary-analog use.

ganges-plain.claim: Alluvial farmland plain; no planetary-analog use.

amazon-forest.claim: Closed-canopy lowland forest; the surface model records canopy, not ground.

black-forest.claim: Forested low mountains; no planetary-analog use.

aletsch.claim: Glaciated high alpine relief, a different formation process.
